Requires Attunement by a character with renown in the Ashen Verdict.

This metal band bears a stylized helm, its nose guard and crest made of deep-blue gems. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent, a stylized O, is stamped inside it.

While wearing this ring, you gain the following benefits (Ashen Verdict renown required in parentheses).

Vengeance (Uncommon, Renown 3+). Your ranged weapon attack rolls ignore Half Cover, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with ranged weapons.

Greater Vengeance (Rare, Renown 10+). Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack roll.

Unmatched Vengeance (Very Rare, Renown 25+). Your ranged attack rolls ignore Three-Quarters Cover, and the maximum range of your ranged weapon attacks is doubled.

Foundry Note

Cover and range are applied by the DM.
